intro.h2: Design-build remodeling in Madison, WI, the Sweeney Way
paragraphs: Sweeney Design Remodel has offered design-build remodeling in Madison, WI since 1954. One team handles the design, the budget and the construction of kitchens, baths, basements and additions, so the people who draw your plans also answer for how they get built.

The difference is timing. Before a contract is written, Sweeney brings its plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners through your home, so problems show up on paper instead of behind your walls. Most of those trade partners have worked with Sweeney for 25 years or more, and when you refer a friend, the same people show up at their house.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths, basements and additions for Dane County homes

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Reworked layouts, opened walls, custom cabinetry, quartz or natural stone tops and layered lighting, plus the panel, plumbing and venting updates behind them. Sweeney kitchens won a NARI Contractor of the Year award in 2006 and a Chrysalis Award in 2005, both in the over-$100,000 class.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in the Sauk Creek area of Madison, WI with a walnut island, white quartzite top, open wood shelves and globe pendants

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary baths that feel cramped often need a smarter layout more than more square feet. Sweeney reworks the flow, builds roomier walk-in showers or soaking-tub retreats, adds vanity storage and sometimes borrows space from a closet next door. Its baths earned NARI Contractor of the Year awards in 2004 and 2013.

image.alt: Primary bathroom in a Madison, WI whole-home remodel with a clawfoot tub, white subway tile and tall double-hung windows

items.name: Basement Remodels
items.blurb: Unfinished or dated lower levels become rec rooms, wet bars, studies, laundry and storage. Sweeney won NARI Contractor of the Year for a basement over $100,000 in 2017, and one Madison client said friends touring her finished basement could not believe it was the same house.

image.alt: Finished basement in Madison, WI with a wet bar, navy herringbone tile wall, brass pendant, wine rack and beverage fridge

items.name: Home Additions and Whole-Home Remodels
items.blurb: Additions and whole-house projects are where one accountable team matters most, because structure, permits, mechanicals and finishes all have to fit together. Sweeney took NARI Contractor of the Year for additions over $250,000 in 2005, 2006 and 2019, and for an entire house in 2017.

image.alt: Hallway in a historic Madison, WI whole-home remodel with additions, with hardwood floors, white millwork and a refinished staircase

items.name: Condo Kitchens and Baths
items.blurb: Condo work means tight galley or peninsula layouts and careful crews in shared buildings. Sweeney has remodeled complete Madison condos, and the president of the Marina Condo Owners Association wrote that the crew protected both his unit and the common areas while keeping residents informed.

image.alt: Madison, WI condo kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinets, glass-front uppers, a navy peninsula and blue upholstered stools

why_choose_us.h2: Why Dane County homeowners call Sweeney back

items.title: Trades in your home during design
items.text: Plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners walk your home with the designers before pricing is final. Most have worked with Sweeney for 25+ years and must be licensed, insured and on time.

items.title: Budgets built from real history
items.text: A Comparative Remodeling Analysis breaks your budget into line items using Sweeney's own past project costs. One client wrote that the price looked higher at first but already covered the unexpected details.

items.title: Certified people on the job
items.text: Tim Sweeney and Rich Deegan are NARI Certified Remodelers, Rich is also a Certified Remodeling Project Manager, and three more team members hold the Certified Lead Carpenter credential.

items.title: A warranty you can read
items.text: Every remodel carries a one-year workmanship warranty covering labor, materials and subcontractor work, and Sweeney transfers manufacturer warranties on products and equipment to you when the job is done.

about.h2: Tim Sweeney and the team behind the Sweeney name
about.text: Tim Sweeney, CR, is President and Project Developer of Sweeney Design Remodel, a Madison company that began in 1954 as a people-centered business. Linda Sweeney is Vice President and Design Consultant. NARI of Madison gave Tim its Image Award in 2006 and again in 2013. The team today includes project developers, an interior designer, a field production manager, an estimator, lead carpenters, carpenters, a painter and an apprentice. Each winner of the in-house Metronome Award passes it on to the colleague who best measures, manages and leads. The firm also coaches high school students at Madison trades career days.

image.alt: Tim Sweeney, CR, President of Sweeney Design Remodel in Madison, WI

process.h2: From a 30-minute call to a warrantied finish

steps.title: Phone call and home visit
steps.text: A 30-minute call covers your needs, budget and timeline. If it fits, a project developer visits to study your space, existing conditions and scope.

steps.title: Design agreement and budget analysis
steps.text: You sign a design agreement and receive a Comparative Remodeling Analysis, a realistic line-by-line budget based on Sweeney's historical project data.

steps.title: Design development and trade walk-through
steps.text: Designers measure, photograph and draw your plans and guide your selections. Then subcontractors and vendors walk your home to head off surprises.

steps.title: Pre-construction
steps.text: Estimators turn drawings and selections into a contract. Sweeney pulls permits, orders materials, builds the schedule and introduces your lead carpenter.

steps.title: Construction and warranty
steps.text: Your project coordinator and lead carpenter run the job with the trades, and the finished work is backed by the one-year workmanship warranty.

service_area.h2: Remodeling in Madison and across Dane County
service_area.text: Sweeney works from its office at 1008 Fish Hatchery Rd in Madison and remodels homes across Dane County. The firm names the towns and neighborhoods below, from Maple Bluff and Shorewood Hills to Sun Prairie, Verona and Waunakee. Reviews on its site come from homeowners in Madison and Waunakee, and from the Marina Condo Owners Association. If your address is nearby but not listed, a short call will tell you whether it fits.

items.q: Do I need to move out during a kitchen remodel?
items.a: Usually not. Most families stay home, but expect noise, dust and short shutoffs of water, power or gas during demolition and rough-in. Some set up a temporary kitchen with a microwave and small appliances, while others book short-term housing. Your design-build team helps you decide based on scope, utility interruptions and your household schedule.

items.q: How does the first step work?
items.a: It starts with a 30-minute phone call about your needs, what is not working in your space, your budget and your hoped-for timeline. If that conversation lines up, Sweeney schedules a visit to your home to look at existing conditions and scope before any design agreement is signed.

items.q: What does the one-year warranty cover?
items.a: If materials or construction show defects under normal use in the first year after completion, Sweeney repairs or replaces them at no cost to you. The warranty covers labor, materials and workmanship by its subcontractors, and manufacturer warranties on materials and equipment are transferred to you as the manufacturer allows.

items.q: Why bring subcontractors in during design?
items.a: Plumbers, electricians and HVAC partners walk your home with the design team before the contract is priced. They flag issues and suggest options while changes still cost nothing but a redraw, which helps prevent surprises, delays and budget overruns later. Most of these partners have worked with Sweeney for more than 25 years.

items.q: Is Sweeney the right size for my project?
items.a: Sweeney handles kitchens, baths, basements, additions and whole homes, and it has also taken on smaller fixes such as railings, windows and repairs for past clients. One homeowner noted that when a project is too big for the team, Sweeney says so and recommends someone else. A phone consult at (608) 257-3034 settles it quickly.

final_cta.h2: Ready to talk straight about your remodel?
final_cta.text: Call (608) 257-3034 for a 30-minute phone consult about your kitchen, bath, basement or addition, or send the project form and the Sweeney team will follow up.

current_site_defects: Measured: Google PageSpeed Insights mobile performance score 40 (verified.pagespeed_mobile).
Home page has no H1 at all; its title tag makes an unsupported claim ('#1 Home Remodeling Design Build Firm In Madison, WI') and the meta description is generic.
Company age is stated three different ways: '60 years of experience' on the home page, 'over six decades' on the warranty page and 'more than 70 years' on the kitchen page. Founded 1954 makes it 72.
The 4.7-star, 25-review Google rating never appears on the site; the reviews page shows only small Google, GuildQuality and Houzz badge images and undated testimonials.
The three Google reviews visible on the profile are 7 to 9 years old, so the site's own testimonials have to carry recent proof.
Nine NARI Contractor of the Year awards, the 1954 start and the one-year warranty are buried on About subpages instead of near the first call to action.
Home page service tiles (Kitchen, Bathroom, Basement, Addition) have no supporting copy, and the trade walk-through that makes the process different is explained only on the Design + Build page.
what_this_homepage_fixes: Keyword H1 and title on 'design-build remodeling Madison WI', with one clear founding year (1954) used everywhere.
Tap-to-call (608) 257-3034 in the hero and closing section, with the existing 'Schedule a phone consult' as the second action.
Google rating, NARI CotY count and the one-year warranty pulled into the hero badges.
Explains the subcontractor walk-through and Comparative Remodeling Analysis on the home page, where comparison shoppers decide.
Five real service blurbs with Madison and Verona project photos and descriptive alt text; full service-area list in text instead of only the footer.
conversion_notes.best_conversion_angle: Seven decades and nine NARI CotY awards behind a design-build process that brings the trades into your home before the price is set, so fewer surprises once walls open.
conversion_notes.outreach_hook: Your home page says 60 years, your kitchen page says 70-plus and Google scores the site 40 on mobile; here is a homepage that leads with 1954, your nine NARI awards and the trade walk-through.
